d:
While the city is overrun by zombies, two sisters manage to escape them. They ran inside a church for shelter but when they are inside, one of them is bitten by the zombie. After witnessed what happen when a person is bitten by the undead they realize that it's only a matter of time before she becomes like them...
In their last moment they decided to spend it together by embracing their body and love with themselves.
